accepted_parent.scope: one aircraft, three fixed two-hour scheduled missions at h8-10/h20-22/h32-34, DAMP=1 and certain BATTLE-LOSS attrition consequence, no ordinary failures, seed1, horizon36

manual_basis: Installed manual physical pp193,425-426,428: DamageItem.IID=<SYSTEM> represents damage rectified by maintenance on the system itself, unlike <ATTRITION> which permanently loses it; DamageRepair supplies damage-specific direct repair TAT. BASE-01 is an accepted WS station; the dictionary pins DamageRepair column order and types.
source_delta: The control is byte-identical to accepted H01.var01 certain attrition. The child changes DamageItem.IID from <ATTRITION> to <SYSTEM>, adds one DamageRepair row for BATTLE-LOSS/TEACH-AIR-01/BASE-01 with DIRPT=1 hour, SURPT=0 and both repair fractions 1, and changes ProblemDescription. DAMP=1, PROB=1, fixed missions, seed and horizon remain identical.

pre_run_hypotheses.attrition: The unchanged control should convert with zero errors, suffer one first-mission BATTLE-LOSS and permanent attrition, aborting the first mission and cancelling later scheduled missions.
pre_run_hypotheses.system: The child should convert with zero errors, log a BATTLE-LOSS system-damage consequence on the first launched mission, perform the explicit one-hour local direct repair after return, restore aircraft readiness before the second scheduled mission, and permit later mission launch. Event and repair times are not preaccepted.
pre_run_hypotheses.alternatives: Converter rejection, damage without a system consequence, no explicit one-hour direct repair, permanent loss, or no later aircraft availability are diagnostic only for the proposed H02 repair contrast. A successful process exit alone is not acceptance.

acceptance_gates: Independent static review of frozen sources, exact diff, manual/dictionary basis and guarded runner before native execution
Two fresh serial session-0 SSH native runs under Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue preserving GUI PID13340
Exact 16/17 authored row-containing table roundtrips and zero converter errors with valid native logs/reports
Control attrition versus child explicit local one-hour direct repair and recovered later sortie, with 72-bin System/Stock/ResultSummary reconciliation
SHA-256 sealed raw evidence and independent read-only post-run replay
limits: The child simultaneously changes consequence IID and introduces explicit DamageRepair; this tests the configured contrast but does not isolate the general fallback priority of DamageReplacement, DamageRepair and ordinary repair.
One seed, one airframe/system damage and one local direct repair do not test damaged LRU, repair fraction, shortage, item/system repair alternatives, GUI visual behavior or cross-engine parity.
